correctness.rationale: The full tetrahedron has fifteen nonempty faces and 28 Hasse cover pairs. An independent endpoint-disjoint matching enumerator generated exactly 14,720 nonempty Hasse matchings, tested directed Hasse-graph acyclicity on each, retaining exactly 12,820 finite simplices with full f=(28,300,1544,3932,4632,2128,256). Recomputing signed chain traces for all 24 S4 vertex permutations produced class Lefschetz (100,2,0,1,0), hence top homology character (99,1,-1,0,-1) after subtracting H0=trivial. The actual verification.py independently crosschecks orbit-block fixed simplex traces and Specht inner products (4,13,8,12,4). Concentration in degree 4 with rank99 follows from Scoville arXiv:2604.18172, Theorem 20/Table 2; the present finite trace recheck alone would not independently prove that homology concentration. Theorem plus complete finite computation suffices for the rational character claim.
